facts.title: electrical release during start-up after maintenance on G-8103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on G-8103 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. G-8103 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 29 July 2014 an incident occurred on G-8103 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during start-up after maintenance, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
